lede: The county's Board of Review and Planning Commission will hear a presentation Tuesday on Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code — building standards that could reshape how structures get approved in the box canyon. Meanwhile, SMART's board meets Wednesday to approve a lease with Telluride Gymnastics Academy, and the library's packed with everything from gardening camp to sound baths.
